name: Gigs Tonight CHS
builder: AI Tech Girlfriends (practice run, not the stage copy)
what_it_does: Tonight's live music in Charleston on one page. Every show at every venue, filtered to what starts in the next few hours, with set times, cover charge, and a one-tap add to your calendar.
target_user: Charleston locals and visitors deciding at 7 PM where to hear live music tonight.

agent_observations.note: People get Gigs Tonight right away and say they would use it. The gap is accessibility: show posters have no text alternatives, the times are low-contrast gray, and the filters only work with a mouse, so a screen reader user cannot find tonight's shows.
